title: Observational Claude Code hook to run lifecycle bridge

claims.text: main resolves the hook binding from _map (sessions or agent_types by session_id and agent_type), derives run_id as hook- plus the first 48 hex digits of sha256 over session, scope and agent identity, then opens or closes that run.

main ignores unsupported events and unmapped identities with exit 0 (stderr note only when --verbose) and returns exit 2 with bad_args on invalid hook or map input and exit 3 with internal on unexpected errors.

main calls agent_get then run_open for start events, and run_beat with a last_assistant_message sha256 then run_close (green, or error for StopFailure) for stop events; subagent events additionally require agent_id and agent_type.

triggers: hook ignored: unmapped identity or unsupported event

decision.rule: Change here when hook event handling, identity mapping, or run open/beat/close bridging for harness hooks needs to change.
decision.failure: A mapped hook session never opens a run, a stop hook closes with the wrong outcome, or an unmapped identity errors instead of being ignored.

questions.q: Where does hook main map a session to an agent binding and derive the hook run_id?
Where should I change how hook main ignores unsupported events or unmapped identities?
Where can I debug why a StopFailure hook closes with the wrong outcome?
